title: Switchboard: taking a customer change from request to verified execution
description: An AI agent investigates customer change requests and prepares findings for review. The application controls independent approval, execution, and delivery verification.
seoTitle: Switchboard | AI Investigation and Approval Workflows | Hanif Carroll
seoDescription: A Python, FastAPI, and LangGraph change-management demo with access-controlled tools, evidence-backed reports, independent approval, and retry-safe execution.
role: Workflow design, backend and agent engineering, frontend, and deployment
problem: Investigating a change request requires checking business records and policies, but a plausible AI answer is not enough authority to change a production configuration.
solution: Built read-only, access-controlled investigation tools and validated structured reports before saving proposals.
Separated investigation, independent approval, execution, and delivery verification, with workspace isolation and atomic updates and receipts.
result: A working public demo using fictional customers and integrations, with isolated visitor workspaces and separate live-model evaluations.
